name: carousel
title: Carousel
description: Slides in a row, one or more in view: square, a hairline round the track and between slides, the arrows as ghost icon buttons with the place in tabular figures between them. Native scroll snap, so a swipe or a trackpad moves it as the arrows do. Never plays on its own.
use_for: A few cards of one kind that don't fit side by side: ways in, posts, examples.
never: Hiding the one thing a page needs inside a slide
Dots for navigation: the count says where you are
source: New in Conare's style (no Conare equivalent): Button ghost icon, the hairline and the console's tabular figures
body: The track fades at an edge with another slide past it (`fade-x`); its hairline stays whole.
